about: Pirates and the corporate legions. Hedda Mraz is the nemesis the game announced but never followed (its 'pirate_vendetta' chain did not exist); spared, she founds a free company in Cargo 2. The legion contracts were declared in the game and never offered; here they lead to the merger that becomes the Terran Mandate.

bounty_war.about: the captain answered Mraz's bounty with a bigger one

mraz_handed.about: the captain handed Hedda Mraz to a legion

mraz_spared.about: the captain let Hedda Mraz go

mraz_hired.about: the captain hired Hedda Mraz as an escort

legion_xylo.about: commission with the Xylo Consortium's legion

vendetta.bounty.title: The bounty
vendetta.bounty.text: Mraz posts a bounty on your ship in every outpost bar between Alpha and Luhman 16. The amount is insulting. You count the zeros twice. Still insulting.

choices.say: Post a bigger one on her

vendetta.convoys.title: Everyone's cargo but yours
vendetta.convoys.text: Mraz starts raiding the ore convoys out of Gamma. She leaves your cargo alone and takes everyone else's. The miners have noticed. So have the legions.

vendetta.terms.title: Hiding in the weather
text: You find Mraz skimming the cloud tops of the brown dwarf below the outpost, hiding in its weather. It is a good hiding place until the fuel runs out.
Her ship is out of fuel and she is out of patience. 'Go on, then,' she says.

choices.say: Hand her to a legion for the bounty
Give her fuel and a head start

text: You find Mraz skimming the cloud tops of the brown dwarf below the outpost, hiding in its weather. It is a good hiding place until the fuel runs out.
Her ship is out of fuel and she is out of patience. 'Go on, then,' she says. 'Collect your own bounty. I hear it is a big one.'

legion.offer.title: Commission
legion.offer.text: The merger talks need a pilot all three legions respect. Each corporation offers you a commission. Each commission has a loyalty clause the other two would call treason.

pirate_captain.name: Hedda Mraz
pirate_captain.about: pirate; holds grudges, keeps count; spared, she founds the Void Angels free company in Cargo 2

meet.pirate_nemesis.title: Ten ships
meet.pirate_nemesis.text: A message arrives on the frequency only your crew uses. 'Ten of my ships,' it says. 'I counted.' It is signed Hedda Mraz.
notes: repair: the game names an event chain 'pirate_vendetta' that does not exist; the vendetta nodes are that chain

questline.combat.1.title: OmniCorp: escort duty
questline.combat.1.text: Escort an OmniCorp ore train out of Gamma. The contract says 'light resistance expected'. It was written by someone who has never been to Gamma.

questline.combat.2.title: Stellar Dynamics: a head for the board
questline.combat.2.text: Stellar Dynamics wants a pirate leader brought in, preferably alive, so the board can be photographed with one.

questline.combat.3.title: Xylo Consortium: war games
questline.combat.3.text: The Xylo Consortium stages war games against the other two legions. The blanks are live rounds with a different invoice.
